targets.title: The tug of war between phonological, semantic and shape information in language-mediated visual search.
targets.evidence_quote: We chose to replicate Experiment 1 reported in Huettig and McQueen (2007) because it allowed us to assess the word-object mapping of different types of information (i.e., phonological, semantic, and visual shape).
targets.outcome_quote: Experiment 1 was conducted to assess whether adults with dyslexia show the same patterns of language-mediated eye gaze as reported in earlier eye-tracking studies with participants with no reading impairments. Eye movements of both adults with dyslexia and control participants closely replicated the earlier research.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicitly identified Experiment 1 replication; both groups closely replicated the earlier gaze patterns. Experiment 2 is the new dyslexia anticipation question; earlier literacy studies motivate it and are discussed as consistent evidence, rather than being specifically designated finding retests.
